posts.name: Aniruddha Jagdale
posts.cooked:
Hi @sayan ,

Referring to Q10 of End Term Mock exercise, can you help understand why the answer “The lines that are repeated twice or more“ is correct but not “The lines that are repeated exactly twice“ ?

image1074×1114 64.8 KB

Kind regards,

Aniruddha

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: If a line is repeated thrice, there will be a time when its 2nd occurrence is being iterated over, and then too the value will be 2 and it will be printed. In its third occurence the value is 3 and nothing happens. Similarly, for any line present 2, or 3, or any number of times more than 2, its frequency will once be 2 when its second occurrence is being iterated over, then it will be printed. Thus it prints all lines with 2 or more freq.

posts.name: Aniruddha Jagdale
posts.cooked:
Ah.. got it. Thanks for the explanation. I misunderstood it for printing twice or more, rather than lines being repeated twice or more.

Thanks!
